Reacher CM Dev 26.11.1-dev.8, a pre-release built from the fork's main.

New since v26.11.1-dev.7:

- Tray icon tooltip and menu
- More RDP settings, like Remote Desktop Manager
- ZMODEM in tmux tabs
- Screenshots of a session
- Login fields back after switching session type
- Network tools: ping, port scan, Wake-on-LAN
- Mute button in the top bar
- Local TFTP, FTP, SFTP and HTTP servers
- Network tools: ping, port scan, Wake-on-LAN
- ZMODEM: no protocol bytes left in the terminal
- tmux windows in a new tab from the terminal bar
- FTP, SFTP and SCP sessions
- Connect to another address or with another login from the session menu
- Saved host keys no longer lost by sync
- tmux in the terminal bar, and a session picker there
- tmux sessions named `reachercm-…`
- Virtual consoles open from web sessions
- Folders for saved credentials
- Transfer queue and easier Compare in the full-pane file manager, and Open file manager from the session menu
- GNOME Remote Login from phones
- Session types grouped in the session editor

iPhone and iPad: add https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rsipka/ReacherCM/update-feed/apps.json as a source in LiveContainer to get updates.
Full list of changes: https://github.com/rsipka/ReacherCM/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
